answer_1.quote: Unlike sequence labeling methods that label each input word with a predefined category, we regard DIE as a translation task that translates source OCR results to a structured format (like key-value pairs in this paper). We use UniLM as the basic model structure, which is a transformer-based pre-trained network that can handle both natural language understanding (NLU) and natural language generation (NLG) tasks simultaneously. Conditioned on a sequence of source words, GMN generates one word at each time step to compose a series of key-value pairs in them.

answer_2.quote: The evaluation metric is the exact match of the entity recognition results in the F1 score.
